depiction.primary_object: clockwise circular arrow with dashed right half
depiction.composition: single circular stroke with arrow tip at top

ambiguity: Almost indistinguishable at list size from standard reload, refresh, redo, or rotate-right icons; the dashed segments on the right side carry no obvious distinction over a solid circular arrow.

modifier_semantics.meaning: in-progress cycle, step-by-step rotation, or partial progress

task_intents: renew an expiring subscription or pass
restart or reboot a server or device
reset a password or factory configuration
repeat a recurring routine or cycle
restore a backup or previous state

example_tasks.task: Do the 6000-mile tire rotation before the mountains trip
Roll over the maturing 6-month Treasury bill into a new one
Rotate pantry canned goods so the 2024 dates sit in front
Reset the garage keypad code after the contractors finish on Friday
Refill the 90-day thyroid prescription through the clinic portal
Restore the Postgres staging database from last night's snapshot
Check expiration dates and pay the annual fee online before the grace period ends
Flip all four corners and vacuum the box spring while the sheets wash
Generate new secrets in Vault and redeploy the three consumer services
Wipe personal accounts, unpair Bluetooth, and run full system restore before trade-in

Rotar los neumáticos delanteros y traseros en el taller

near_misses.task: Return the defective toaster to Target for a refund
Turn around the living room sofa to face the window
Buy a rechargeable rotating electric scrubber for the bathroom tiles

Call the landlord to ask about the lease terms

reasoning: A clockwise circular arrow with a dashed right half, read as rotate, reload/restart, renew, or repeat/cycle. It fits tasks centered on restarting devices, rotating items, or renewing recurring obligations, though specific object icons (passport, tire, router) usually beat an abstract action arrow and it closely resembles several other circular arrow glyphs.
